title: Settings
description: Choose how Walday presents language, dates, weather units, and your weather location. Preferences are stored on this device only.

guestNotice.heading: Stored on this device
guestNotice.description: Preferences are kept in this browser. Clearing site data or using another device removes them.

source.browser: Following your browser language. The current language is {{language}}.
source.explicit: The selected language overrides the browser language.

dateTime.help: Dates use your device timezone and the regional format of your language.

units.help: Unit conversion affects display only. Stored weather values are never changed.

location.help: Search for a place and select it explicitly. Coordinates are used only for weather retrieval.
location.queryHelp: Enter between 1 and 80 characters. Search uses the Walday weather service.
location.empty: No places found. Try another search.
location.attribution: Location search results are provided by the Walday weather service.

errors.unavailable: Location search is unavailable right now. Other preferences remain available.
errors.timeout: Location search took too long. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a moment and try again.

validation.locationQueryInvalid: Enter a place name between 1 and 80 characters.
validation.locationLabelInvalid: That place could not be used as a saved location. Select another result.

sessionOnly.unavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Your changes apply for this session only.
sessionOnly.quota: Local storage is full. Your changes apply for this session only.
sessionOnly.write-failed: Preferences could not be saved. Your changes apply for this session only.
sessionOnly.cleared: Stored preferences were cleared elsewhere. Your changes apply for this session only.

storage.conflictDescription: Another tab saved newer preferences. Your draft has been kept, but it will not overwrite the newer values.
storage.partialHeading: Some preferences could not be restored
storage.partialDescription: Valid preferences were restored. The stored record is preserved until you replace it.
storage.corruptHeading: Stored preferences could not be read
storage.migrationFailedHeading: Stored preferences could not be upgraded
storage.protectedDescription: Safe defaults are in use. The stored record is preserved until you explicitly replace it.
storage.unsupportedHeading: Stored preferences use a newer version
storage.unsupportedDescription: This version of Walday cannot read the stored preferences safely. They are preserved until you explicitly replace them.

discard.heading: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.description: You have unsaved preference changes. Leaving now discards them.

replace.heading: Replace stored preferences?
replace.description: The stored record could not be read completely. Saving now replaces it with your current settings.

feedback.sessionOnly: Preferences applied for this session only. They were not saved.
feedback.conflict: Preferences were saved in another tab. Reload or discard your draft to continue.
feedback.restoredMigrated: Older preferences were upgraded and restored.
feedback.restoredPartial: Some preferences could not be restored. Valid settings were applied.
feedback.clearedElsewhere: Preferences were cleared in another tab.
feedback.updatedElsewhere: Preferences were updated in another tab.
feedback.newerData: Another tab changed preferences to a newer version that cannot be applied here.
